title: 받침 ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅂ: 끝소리 멈추기 연습
summary: Practice reading and recognizing unreleased final stops for batchim ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ. Learners link each to similar English word-final sounds (back/bat/cap) but with no release, then read and choose simple words that contain these batchim.
objective: Beginner learners will recognize unreleased final stops [k], [t], [p] for batchim ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ; connect them to similar English endings (“back/bat/cap” with no release); and accurately read and select simple Korean words that contain these batchim.
exercises: 아래 낱말의 끝소리는 무엇인가요? 곧 (k / t / p)
「집」의 끝소리와 가장 가까운 영어 낱말의 끝소리는? (back / bat / cap)
로마자 표기가 맞는 것을 고르세요: 벽 (byeok / byeog / byuk)
끝소리가 [p]인 낱말을 모두 고르세요. (집 / 속 / 입 / 곧)

letters.as: like the end of “back” (stop; no release)
like the end of “bat” (stop; no release)
like the end of “cap” (stop; no release)

words.exampleMeaning: The book in the bag is heavy.
I want to receive a present.
I am walking in the park.

words.meaning: clothes (batchim ㅅ is pronounced [t] at the end: 옷 → [옫])
daytime (batchim ㅈ is pronounced [t] at the end: 낮 → [낟])
